audit.why: Shen x4, Skill at level 6 and first item, Shen at 2+ items — packet.levelChart, win[] and phases[].side all agree.
audit.corrected: No chart edits. Mid-game spike text now carries Ki Barrier's per-cast refresh and Locke's R grounding as the real level-6 lever.

audit.whatIsWrong: wants.you[1] tells you to dodge 'his Q vorpal-sword taunt-window' — it merges two different abilities. The page also calls Twilight Assault a straightforward slow, credits the shield vaguely to 'sustain and shields', and never states what Spirit's Refuge actually blocks.
audit.why: The taunt is Shadow Dash (E), a 600-range dash on 18/16/14/12/10s costing 150 mana; Twilight Assault (Q) is the spirit blade, max-health damage, empowered only when the blade collides with a champion, and its slow applies only to enemies running away from Shen. Spirit's Refuge blocks attacks near the blade — abilities pass through it, which is what makes Locke's Q and R still usable inside it. Ki Barrier shields after every spell cast and its cooldown shortens when he affects champions.
audit.corrected: Taunt attributed to Shadow Dash; Q restated as max-health blade damage with a run-away slow; Spirit's Refuge restated as an attack block, which is precisely why it kills on-hit and not your abilities; Ki Barrier named.

audit.whatIsWrong: Locke's R grounding is never connected to Shadow Dash.
audit.why: Shadow Dash is Shen's only dash and his escape after an over-extended taunt; grounding it is the concrete reason to hold R.

edits.before: Shen wins the early exchanges here — respect his level-2/3 Q (Twilight Assault) which slows and hits hard, and never W into him while his Spirit's Refuge is up because it eats every Silver Stake on-hit you rely on. Farm safe, take short trades only when his Q is on cooldown.
edits.after: Shen wins the early exchanges here — respect his level-2/3 Q (Twilight Assault), which hits for max health and slows you only as you run away, and never W into him while Spirit's Refuge is up because it blocks the attacks your on-hit needs. Trade only while his Q's 8-second cooldown runs.

edits.before: Through 6 the lane stays Shen-favoured: he sustains your poke, shields his own trades, and his R (Stand United) lets him leave lane even if you shove. Your only real windows are Q-mark burst combos when his W is down, and using E's reset to punish an over-extended taunt.
edits.after: Through 6 the lane stays Shen-favoured: Ki Barrier shields him off every cast and his R (Stand United) lets him leave lane even if you shove. Your windows are Q-mark burst combos while his W is down, and your R's grounding, which shuts off Shadow Dash so an over-extended taunt cannot walk home.

edits.before: Use E (Ashen Pursuit) to dodge his Q vorpal-sword taunt-window
edits.after: Use E (Ashen Pursuit) once his Shadow Dash taunt is spent

edits.before: Time W (Spirit's Refuge) to eat your Silver Stake AA procs during your all-in
edits.after: Time W (Spirit's Refuge) to eat every attack that your on-hit burst needs

notes: wants.you[1] blended Twilight Assault and Shadow Dash into one 'Q taunt' — the taunt is E, on 18/16/14/12/10s and 150 mana. Spirit's Refuge blocks attacks only, which is exactly why it turns off Locke's on-hit while his abilities keep landing; the page never said this and it changes how you spend a trade. I kept 'Silver Stake' out of the fields I touched, matching the mirror audit — Locke's kit file carries no ability names and that one matches nothing in the interaction file either.
